basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old aspiring content creator from Boise, Idaho. I recently graduated with a degree in Digital Media and am diving into the world of YouTube. I love binge-watching tech reviews and am obsessed with improving my video editing skills to grow my channel. I’m a night owl, often online from 10 PM to 2 AM. Currently single, I work part-time at a local electronics store, which helps me stay updated with the latest gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational knowledge of video editing and content creation from my university studies. I am self-teaching myself about YouTube algorithms, primarily through online courses and forums. My focus is on learning what attracts viewers, specifically through video thumbnails and titles.
